```{r}
full_data <- data.table::fread("../data/raw/big_data_bowl_2023_AllWeeks.csv")

players2 <- data.table::fread("../data/raw/players-2.csv")
```

```{r}
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      pff_sackAllowed      == 1 ~ "sack",
      pff_hitAllowed       == 1 ~ "hit",
      pff_hurryAllowed     == 1 ~ "hurry",
      pff_beatenByDefender == 1 ~ "beaten",
      pff_beatenByDefender == 0 &
        is.na(pff_sackAllowed) &
        is.na(pff_hitAllowed) &
        is.na(pff_hurryAllowed) ~ "won",
      pff_beatenByDefender == 0 &
        pff_sackAllowed == 0 & pff_hitAllowed == 0 & pff_hurryAllowed == 0 ~ "won",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

pass_rusher_positions <- c("DE","DT","OLB","ILB","NT","SS","DB","LB","MLB","FS","CB")


init_play_ratings <- players2 %>%
  transmute(
    nflId            = as.character(nflId),
    displayName,
    officialPosition,
    Defense          = officialPosition %in% pass_rusher_positions,
    Offense          = officialPosition %in% c("C","G","T","TE","FB","WR","RB","QB"),
    Player_Elo       = ifelse(Defense, 800, 1200)
  )

valid_rushers <- init_play_ratings %>%
  filter(Defense) %>%
  pull(nflId)


interactions_pr <- full_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>%  
  transmute(
    gameId,
    playId,
    blocker_nflId = as.character(nflId),
    rusher_nflId  = as.character(pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer),
    outcome       = response
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%                        # <<< deduplicate frames!
  filter(rusher_nflId %in% valid_rushers)
penalties_long <- full_data %>%
  select(gameId, playId,
         foulName1, foulNFLId1,
         foulName2, foulNFLId2,
         foulName3, foulNFLId3) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("foul"),
    names_to = c(".value", "penalty_num"),
    names_pattern = "(foulName|foulNFLId)([123])"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    penalty_name = foulName,
    penalty_id   = foulNFLId
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(penalty_id)) %>%
  mutate(penalty_id = as.character(penalty_id))

rusher_penalties <- penalties_long %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId, rusher_nflId = penalty_id) %>%
  arrange(penalty_num) %>%
  summarise(
    rusher_penalty1 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "1"][1],
    rusher_penalty2 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "2"][1],
    rusher_penalty3 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "3"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

blocker_penalties <- penalties_long %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId, blocker_nflId = penalty_id) %>%
  arrange(penalty_num) %>%
  summarise(
    blocker_penalty1 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "1"][1],
    blocker_penalty2 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "2"][1],
    blocker_penalty3 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "3"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

interactions_pr <- interactions_pr %>%
  left_join(rusher_penalties,  by = c("gameId", "playId", "rusher_nflId")) %>%
  left_join(blocker_penalties, by = c("gameId", "playId", "blocker_nflId"))

setDT(interactions_pr)

elo_vec <- setNames(init_play_ratings$Player_Elo, init_play_ratings$nflId)

block_pens <- c("Offensive Holding", "Illegal Use of Hands", "Chop Block", "Face Mask (15 Yards)", "Clipping") 
rush_pens <- c("Illegal Use of Hands", "Face Mask (15 Yards)", "Defensive Holding")

interactions_pr <- interactions_pr %>%
  mutate(
    blocker_penalty1 = ifelse(blocker_penalty1 %in% block_pens,blocker_penalty1,NA_character_),
    blocker_penalty2 = ifelse(blocker_penalty2 %in% block_pens,blocker_penalty2,NA_character_),
    blocker_penalty3 = ifelse(blocker_penalty3 %in% block_pens,blocker_penalty3,NA_character_),
    rusher_penalty1 = ifelse(rusher_penalty1 %in% rush_pens, rusher_penalty1, NA_character_),
    rusher_penalty2 = ifelse(rusher_penalty2 %in% rush_pens, rusher_penalty2, NA_character_),
    rusher_penalty3 = ifelse(rusher_penalty3 %in% rush_pens, rusher_penalty3, NA_character_),
  )

interactions_pr <- interactions_pr %>%
  group_by(gameId,playId, rusher_nflId) %>%
  mutate(n_blockers_for_rusher = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

interactions_pr <- interactions_pr %>%
  mutate(
    rusher_penalty = if_any(starts_with("rusher_penalty"), ~ !is.na(.)),
    blocker_penalty = if_any(starts_with("blocker_penalty"), ~ !is.na(.)),
    response_mod = case_when(
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "sack"   ~ "hit",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "hit"    ~ "hurry",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "hurry"  ~ "beaten",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "beaten" ~ "won",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "won"    ~ "won",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "won"    ~ "beaten",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "beaten" ~ "hurry",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "hurry"  ~ "hit",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "hit"    ~ "sack",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "sack"   ~ "sack",
      rusher_penalty & blocker_penalty                        ~ outcome,
      TRUE                                                    ~ outcome
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-rusher_penalty, -blocker_penalty)
```

```{r}
interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr

elo_vec_1 <- elo_vec

interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr_1 %>%
  group_by(rusher_nflId) %>%
  mutate(rusher_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(blocker_nflId) %>%
  mutate(blocker_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

adaptive_K_prov <- function(n,
                            K_start = 20,
                            K_min   = 10,
                            n_prov  = 50,
                            n_decay = 100) {
  k <- ifelse(
    n <= n_prov,
    K_min,
    ifelse(
      n <= n_decay,
      K_start + (K_min - K_start) * (n - n_prov) / (n_decay - n_prov),
      K_min
    )
  )
  pmax(k, K_min)
}
interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr_1 %>%
  group_by(rusher_nflId) %>%
    mutate(rusher_k  = adaptive_K_prov(rusher_row,
                                      K_start = 20,
                                      K_min   = 10,
                                      n_prov  = 50,
                                      n_decay = 100)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(blocker_nflId) %>%
    mutate(blocker_k = adaptive_K_prov(blocker_row,
                                      K_start = 20,
                                      K_min   = 10,
                                      n_prov  = 50,
                                      n_decay = 100)) %>%
  ungroup()

interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr_1 %>%
  select(-c(rusher_penalty3,blocker_penalty3))

setDT(interactions_pr_1)

interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr_1[
  order(gameId, playId)             
][
  , .SD[1],                         
  by = .(gameId, playId, blocker_nflId, rusher_nflId)
][
  , row_id := .I                    
]


all_ids <- unique(c(interactions_pr_1$blocker_nflId, interactions_pr_1$rusher_nflId))


rushers  <- unique(interactions_pr_1$rusher_nflId)
blockers <- unique(interactions_pr_1$blocker_nflId)


elo_vec_1 <- setNames(
  ifelse(all_ids %in% rushers, 800, 1200),
  all_ids
)


get_elo <- function(id) {
  if (!id %in% names(elo_vec_1)) {
    elo_vec_1[[id]] <<- 1000               
  }
  elo_vec_1[[id]]
}

elo_outcome_value <- function(response_mod) {
  case_when(
    response_mod == "won"    ~ 1,
    response_mod == "beaten"  ~ 0.7,
    response_mod == "hurry"    ~ 0.55,
    response_mod == "hit" ~ 0.45,
    response_mod == "sack"   ~ 0
  )
}

## --- 1.  hyper-parameter ---------------------------------------------
halflife <- 30                            # plays; tune this later
alpha    <- 1 - exp(log(0.5) / halflife)  # EWMA weight

## --- 2.  initialise two vectors --------------------------------------
all_ids <- unique(c(interactions_pr_1$blocker_nflId,
                    interactions_pr_1$rusher_nflId))

rushers  <- unique(interactions_pr_1$rusher_nflId)
raw_elo     <- setNames(ifelse(all_ids %in% rushers,  800, 1200), all_ids)
smooth_elo  <- raw_elo                                # start equal

## --- 3.  helper -------------------------------------------------------
elo_step <- function(belo, relo, outcome, bK, rK,
                     n_blockers_for_rusher = 1, scale = 400) {
  res_val <- elo_outcome_value(outcome)
  if (is.na(res_val)) return(c(b = belo, r = relo))          # no change

  adj_belo   <- belo + 100 * log2(n_blockers_for_rusher)     # bonus
  expect_blk <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((relo - adj_belo) / scale))

  c(
    b = belo + bK * ( res_val        - expect_blk),
    r = relo + rK * ((1 - res_val)   - (1 - expect_blk))
  )
}

## --- 4.  prep history table ------------------------------------------
elo_history <- interactions_pr_1[
  , .(gameId, playId, row_id,
      blocker_nflId, rusher_nflId, response_mod,
      rusher_row, blocker_row,
      blocker_k, rusher_k, n_blockers_for_rusher,
      before_blocker_raw   = NA_real_,   before_blocker_sm  = NA_real_,
      before_rusher_raw    = NA_real_,   before_rusher_sm   = NA_real_,
      after_blocker_raw    = NA_real_,   after_blocker_sm   = NA_real_,
      after_rusher_raw     = NA_real_,   after_rusher_sm    = NA_real_)
]

## --- 5.  main loop ----------------------------------------------------
for (i in seq_len(nrow(elo_history))) {

  b_id <- elo_history$blocker_nflId[i]
  r_id <- elo_history$rusher_nflId[i]
  out  <- elo_history$response_mod[i]
  bK   <- elo_history$blocker_k[i]
  rK   <- elo_history$rusher_k[i]
  nblk <- elo_history$n_blockers_for_rusher[i]

  # ratings *used for the probability* are the SMOOTHED ones
  b_sm <- smooth_elo[[b_id]]
  r_sm <- smooth_elo[[r_id]]

  # store "before" snapshots
  elo_history[i,
    `:=`(before_blocker_raw = raw_elo[[b_id]],
         before_blocker_sm  = b_sm,
         before_rusher_raw  = raw_elo[[r_id]],
         before_rusher_sm   = r_sm)
  ]

  # update the RAW Elo values
  new_raw <- elo_step(raw_elo[[b_id]], raw_elo[[r_id]],
                      out, bK, rK,
                      n_blockers_for_rusher = nblk)

  raw_elo[[b_id]] <- new_raw["b"]
  raw_elo[[r_id]] <- new_raw["r"]

  # one-step EWMA smoothing
  smooth_elo[[b_id]] <- (1 - alpha) * b_sm + alpha * raw_elo[[b_id]]
  smooth_elo[[r_id]] <- (1 - alpha) * r_sm + alpha * raw_elo[[r_id]]

  # store the "after" snapshots
  elo_history[i,
    `:=`(after_blocker_raw = raw_elo[[b_id]],
         after_blocker_sm  = smooth_elo[[b_id]],
         after_rusher_raw  = raw_elo[[r_id]],
         after_rusher_sm   = smooth_elo[[r_id]])
  ]
}

scale <- 400          # same logistic scale you use in elo_step
df    <- elo_history  # has *_raw and *_sm columns now

## proportions of non-“won” outcomes (same for both rating types)
freqs <- df %>% 
  filter(response_mod != "won") %>% 
  count(response_mod) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

## -------- helper that does one rating flavour ------------------------
calc_loss <- function(data, flavour = c("raw", "sm")) {
  flavour <- match.arg(flavour)
  
  # pick the right column names
  b_col <- paste0("before_blocker_", flavour)
  r_col <- paste0("before_rusher_" , flavour)
  
  tmp <- data %>% 
    mutate(
      p_block  = 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((.data[[r_col]] - .data[[b_col]]) / scale)),
      p_rusher = 1 - p_block,
      p_sack   = p_rusher * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "sack"],
      p_hit    = p_rusher * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "hit"],
      p_hurry  = p_rusher * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "hurry"],
      p_beaten = p_rusher * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "beaten"],
      p_won    = p_block,
      response_mod = factor(response_mod,
                            levels = c("sack","hit","hurry","beaten","won"))
    )
  
  ## per-class log-loss
  per_class <- tmp %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = starts_with("p_"),
      names_to  = "prob_col",
      values_to = "prob"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(class = sub("^p_", "", prob_col)) %>% 
    group_by(class) %>% 
    summarise(
      n             = n(),
      class_logloss = -mean(if_else(response_mod == class,
                                    log(prob), NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  ## overall
  overall <- tmp %>% 
    mutate(
      logloss = case_when(
        response_mod == "sack"   ~ -log(p_sack),
        response_mod == "hit"    ~ -log(p_hit),
        response_mod == "hurry"  ~ -log(p_hurry),
        response_mod == "beaten" ~ -log(p_beaten),
        response_mod == "won"    ~ -log(p_won)
      )
    ) %>% 
    summarise(overall_logloss = mean(logloss, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  list(per_class = per_class, overall = overall)
}

## -------- run for RAW and SMOOTHED ratings --------------------------
loss_raw <- calc_loss(df, "raw")
loss_sm  <- calc_loss(df, "sm")

## inspect
loss_raw$overall
loss_sm$overall
loss_raw$per_class
loss_sm$per_class
```

```{r}
get_rating <- function(v, id, default) {
  r <- v[id]                # safe lookup; returns NA if not present
  if (is.na(r)) default else r
}
```

```{r}
############################################################################
#  PACKAGES (minimal, explicit)
############################################################################
library(data.table);  library(dplyr);  library(tidyr)
library(purrr);       library(tibble); library(dials)
library(future);      library(furrr);  library(readr);  library(glue)

plan(multisession, workers = future::availableCores())

############################################################################
# 1 · parameter-constructor helpers  (use ONLY new_quant_param)
############################################################################
make_num <- function(id, range) {
  p <- dials::new_quant_param(type = "double",  range = range, inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  p$id <- id; p$label <- setNames(id, id); p
}
make_int <- function(id, range) {
  p <- dials::new_quant_param(type = "integer", range = range, inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  p$id <- id; p$label <- setNames(id, id); p
}

############################################################################
# 2 · search space   →   80-point Latin-hypercube grid
############################################################################
param_set <- dials::parameters(
  make_num("init_blocker", c(1000, 1400)),
  make_num("init_rusher",  c( 600, 1000)),
  make_num("scale",        c( 250,  600)),
  make_int("K_start",      c(   5,   40)),
  make_int("K_min",        c(   5,   20)),
  make_int("n_prov",       c(  10,  100)),
  make_int("n_decay",      c(  50,  200)),
  make_int("halflife",     c(  10,   60))
)

set.seed(2025)
param_grid <- dials::grid_latin_hypercube(param_set, size = 80) %>%
  mutate(.iter = row_number())

############################################################################
# 3 · Elo utilities  (safe look-up uses get_rating() you already defined)
############################################################################
scale_logistic <- 400

elo_outcome_value <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(
  x == "won"    ~ 1,
  x == "beaten" ~ 0.7,
  x == "hurry"  ~ 0.55,
  x == "hit"    ~ 0.45,
  x == "sack"   ~ 0
)

adaptive_K_prov <- function(n, K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay) {
  k <- ifelse(
    n <= n_prov, K_min,
    ifelse(
      n <= n_decay,
      K_start + (K_min - K_start) * (n - n_prov) / (n_decay - n_prov),
      K_min))
  pmax(k, K_min)
}

elo_step <- function(belo, relo, outcome, bK, rK,
                     n_block = 1, scale = scale_logistic) {
  v <- elo_outcome_value(outcome)
  if (is.na(v)) return(c(b = belo, r = relo))
  adj_belo <- belo + 100 * log2(n_block)
  exp_blk  <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((relo - adj_belo) / scale))
  c(
    b = belo + bK * ( v           - exp_blk),
    r = relo + rK * ((1 - v)      - (1 - exp_blk))
  )
}

############################################################################
# 4 · split interactions_pr  (80 % train / 20 % valid)
############################################################################
setDT(interactions_pr)
split_idx <- floor(0.80 * nrow(interactions_pr))
train_tbl <- interactions_pr[1:split_idx]
valid_tbl <- interactions_pr[(split_idx + 1):nrow(interactions_pr)]

############################################################################
# 5 · fit_and_score_once   (uses get_rating() for SAFE look-ups)
############################################################################
fit_and_score_once <- function(train_tbl, valid_tbl,
                               init_blocker, init_rusher, scale,
                               K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay,
                               halflife,
                               default_blocker = 1200,
                               default_rusher  = 800) {

  all_ids <- unique(c(train_tbl$blocker_nflId, train_tbl$rusher_nflId))
  rushers <- unique(train_tbl$rusher_nflId)
  raw_elo    <- setNames(ifelse(all_ids %in% rushers, init_rusher, init_blocker), all_ids)
  smooth_elo <- raw_elo
  alpha      <- 1 - exp(log(0.5) / halflife)

  train_tbl <- train_tbl %>%
    group_by(rusher_nflId)  %>%
    mutate(rusher_row = row_number(),
           rusher_k   = adaptive_K_prov(rusher_row, K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(blocker_nflId) %>%
    mutate(blocker_row = row_number(),
           blocker_k   = adaptive_K_prov(blocker_row, K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay)) %>%
    ungroup()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(train_tbl))) {
    row <- train_tbl[i, ]

    b_raw <- get_rating(raw_elo, row$blocker_nflId, init_blocker)
    r_raw <- get_rating(raw_elo, row$rusher_nflId,  init_rusher)

    new_raw <- elo_step(b_raw, r_raw,
                        row$response_mod,
                        row$blocker_k, row$rusher_k,
                        row$n_blockers_for_rusher,
                        scale)

    raw_elo[row$blocker_nflId] <- new_raw["b"]
    raw_elo[row$rusher_nflId ] <- new_raw["r"]

    smooth_elo[row$blocker_nflId] <-
      (1 - alpha) * get_rating(smooth_elo, row$blocker_nflId, init_blocker) +
       alpha      * new_raw["b"]
    smooth_elo[row$rusher_nflId]  <-
      (1 - alpha) * get_rating(smooth_elo, row$rusher_nflId,  init_rusher)  +
       alpha      * new_raw["r"]
  }

  freq <- train_tbl %>%
    filter(response_mod != "won") %>%
    count(response_mod) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    deframe()

probs <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  valid_tbl$blocker_nflId,
  valid_tbl$rusher_nflId,
  function(bid, rid) {

    b_rating <- get_rating(smooth_elo, bid, default_blocker)
    r_rating <- get_rating(smooth_elo, rid, default_rusher)

    p_block  <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((r_rating - b_rating) / scale_logistic))
    p_rusher <- 1 - p_block

    tibble(
      p_sack   = p_rusher * freq["sack"],
      p_hit    = p_rusher * freq["hit"],
      p_hurry  = p_rusher * freq["hurry"],
      p_beaten = p_rusher * freq["beaten"],
      p_won    = p_block
    )
  }
)

  ll <- case_when(
    valid_tbl$response_mod == "sack"   ~ -log(probs$p_sack),
    valid_tbl$response_mod == "hit"    ~ -log(probs$p_hit),
    valid_tbl$response_mod == "hurry"  ~ -log(probs$p_hurry),
    valid_tbl$response_mod == "beaten" ~ -log(probs$p_beaten),
    TRUE                                ~ -log(probs$p_won)
  )

  mean(ll, na.rm = TRUE)
}

############################################################################
# 6 · objective wrapper (one row per trial)
############################################################################
score_candidate <- function(.iter,
                            init_blocker, init_rusher, scale,
                            K_start, K_min, n_prov, n_decay, halflife) {

  loss <- fit_and_score_once(
    train_tbl, valid_tbl,
    init_blocker, init_rusher, scale,
    K_start,     K_min,       n_prov, n_decay,
    halflife
  )

  tibble(.iter        = .iter,
         .estimate    = -loss,
         init_blocker = init_blocker,
         init_rusher  = init_rusher,
         scale        = scale,
         K_start      = K_start,
         K_min        = K_min,
         n_prov       = n_prov,
         n_decay      = n_decay,
         halflife     = halflife)
}

############################################################################
# 7 · evaluate 80 trials in parallel (safe look-ups)
############################################################################
grid_results <- future_pmap_dfr(
  .l = param_grid,
  .f = ~ score_candidate(
          .iter        = ..9,
          init_blocker = ..1, init_rusher = ..2, scale = ..3,
          K_start = ..4, K_min = ..5, n_prov = ..6, n_decay = ..7, halflife = ..8),
  .progress = TRUE
)

############################################################################
# 8 · log, pick best, refit on all data, report
############################################################################
write_csv(grid_results, "../data/results/elo_tuning_log.csv")

best_row <- grid_results %>% arrange(.estimate) %>% slice(1)
```
